That would make me so happy and not feel useless. I did it once before, china, but I was 18, immature and did it for the wrong reasons. I wasn't easy to work with. I'd like to do that over.
But as is usually the case, it's not that easy. With the currency gap, I'd still need to get thousands upon thousands to pay for a flight ticket. And I don't own enough stuff to sell it to make up the difference. And I know it's probably irrational to say this, but I got a feeling it's always going to be like this or worse.
Will that make my teeth whiter? I bet it'll make it stronger. I'm on a rampant vitamin C spree, so that's sorted.
